help.title: DressApp: My DressApp Closet Book
help.subtitle: A Super Simple Guide to Managing Your Clothes & Outfits
help.geminiKeyStep: An optional personal AI key if you wish to connect your own cloud account.
help.overview_p1: Welcome to DressApp! DressApp is your smart digital wardrobe and personal style assistant.
help.overview_p2: Take or upload pictures of your clothes to organize your closet in seconds. Your AI Stylist checks your wardrobe and the local weather to help you pick the right outfit for any occasion!
help.overview_p3: You can also try on outfits on your personal avatar, pack for trips, track your wardrobe's value, and buy, sell, or swap clothes with the community.
help.prereq_p1: To get started with DressApp, all you need is:
help.prereq_item1: A phone, tablet, or computer with a modern web browser and an internet connection.
help.prereq_item2: A camera or saved photos on your device to add your clothes.
help.prereq_item3: A microphone if you want to speak out loud with your AI Stylist.
help.prereq_item4: No technical setup required! Free accounts include DressApp's on-premises AI model right out of the box, while paid plans unlock our cutting-edge AI model.
help.add_clothes_p1: Bring your wardrobe into DressApp in just a few taps—whether you photograph a single piece, a full outfit you are wearing, or an entire cluster of clothes in your physical closet.
help.add_clothes_step1: Open DressApp and tap the **Add Item** button.
help.add_clothes_step2: Choose **Take Photo** or **Upload Photos** to add a single garment, a full worn outfit, or — on **Manager** and **Professional** plans, or **Free** accounts with **15+ AI reconstruction credits** — a **Cluster photo** of garments hanging in your closet, a rack of shoes, or a pile of shirts.
help.add_clothes_step3: Cluster garment uploading uses Nano Banana AI studio reconstruction (up to 15 items per photo). Free users unlock Cluster Upload whenever their AI reconstruction credit balance is **15 or more** (via AI credit packs on the Pricing page), or by upgrading to Manager or Professional.
help.add_clothes_step4: Keep the 5 cluster upload fallbacks in mind: (a) best for solid or simple plaid/striped patterns—cannot read hidden prints or fine details, (b) rarely reflects current garment condition, (c) may skip some garments, (d) can hallucinate patterns and colors, and (e) consumes reconstruction credits.
help.add_clothes_step5: Review the detected details—such as category, color, season, and style (including sweatshirts, hoodies, and traditional attire)—and adjust anything you like.
help.add_clothes_step6: Tap **Save** to add the items to your digital closet!
help.stylist_p1: Your personal AI Stylist helps you decide what to wear for any occasion—you can type or talk to it just like a friend!
help.stylist_step1: Open the **AI Stylist** tab from the main menu.
help.stylist_step2: Tap the **Microphone** button to speak, or type your question in the chat box.
help.stylist_step3: Ask any styling question, such as: 'What should I wear with my blue jeans for a rainy workday?'
help.stylist_step4: Your words appear on the screen as you speak, and your request is sent to the Stylist.
help.stylist_step5: The Stylist checks the local weather, your calendar, and your closet to put together a complete outfit for you.
help.stylist_step6: Listen to the Stylist's spoken advice, tap **Play Reply** to hear it again, or save the suggested outfit to your collection!
help.profile_p1: Your Profile lets you personalize how DressApp fits, styles, and speaks to you:
help.profile_item1_desc: Customize your realistic 3D Dynamic Avatar (which adapts to your measurements and 8 natural skin tones) or upload a full-body photo for personal try-ons. DressApp maps every garment and accessory to your exact shoulder, chest, waist, hip, arm, leg, and foot landmarks, and lets you toggle the Point-Cloud Fit Mesh.
help.profile_item2_desc: Tell the Stylist your favorite styles, preferred colors, items you want to avoid, and your modesty preference so every suggestion feels comfortable for you.
help.profile_item3_desc: Add your name, phone number for notifications, and home address with automatic street and city lookup.
help.profile_item4_desc: Enter four basic measurements (Height, Weight, Waist, and Foot Length) and DressApp automatically estimates the rest of your body measurements (Shoulders, Chest, Hips, Sleeve, Inseam, and Outseam) to help you find the right fit.
help.profile_item5_desc: Share your daily routine and occupation so outfit suggestions and fashion trends match your everyday life.
help.profile_item6_desc: Switch anytime between metric (cm / kg) and imperial (in / lb) units across all sizing fields.
help.profile_item7_desc: If you are a professional stylist, tailor, or designer, register your business profile to appear in the Stylist Directory and launch local promotions.
help.profile_item8_desc: Add your PayPal email to receive earnings when you sell items in the Marketplace.
help.profile_item9_desc: DressApp works right out of the box with no technical setup! Free accounts run on DressApp's on-premises AI model, while Manager ($10/mo) and Professional ($15/mo) plans unlock our cutting-edge AI model for faster analysis and advanced styling.
help.profile_item10_desc: Check your current plan and available closet space, or share your referral link with friends to earn +10 free item slots per friend (up to 150 items on the Free plan).
help.profile_item11_desc: Schedule daily morning outfit notifications and connect your calendar so your daily looks match your meetings, events, and trips.
help.profile_item12_desc: Choose from 13 supported languages, pick your AI Stylist's voice, and enable location access for local weather forecasts and nearby offers.
help.stats_p1: Understand the value of your closet, see what you wear most, and shop smarter:

sections.prereq_item2: A camera or saved photos on your device to add your clothes.
sections.prereq_item3: A microphone if you want to speak out loud with your AI Stylist.
sections.prereq_item4: No technical setup required! Free accounts include DressApp's on-premises AI model right out of the box, while paid plans unlock our cutting-edge AI model.

sections.add_clothes_step1: Open DressApp and tap the **Add Item** button.
sections.add_clothes_step2: Choose **Take Photo** or **Upload Photos** to add one or more pictures at once, or import items from an online store link or digital receipt.
sections.add_clothes_step3: DressApp automatically checks if you already added an item so you don't save duplicates by mistake.
sections.add_clothes_step4: Whether a photo shows one item, a full outfit on a person, or several clothes side by side, DressApp's AI automatically separates each piece and removes the background.
sections.add_clothes_step5: Review the detected details—such as category, color, season, and style (including sweatshirts, hoodies, and traditional attire)—and adjust anything you like.
sections.add_clothes_step6: Tap **Save** to add the items to your digital closet!
sections.stylist_p1: Your personal AI Stylist helps you decide what to wear for any occasion—you can type or talk to it just like a friend!
sections.stylist_step1: Open the **AI Stylist** tab from the main menu.
sections.stylist_step2: Tap the **Microphone** button to speak, or type your question in the chat box.
sections.stylist_step3: Ask any styling question, such as: 'What should I wear with my blue jeans for a rainy workday?'
sections.stylist_step4: Your words appear on the screen as you speak, and your request is sent to the Stylist.
sections.stylist_step5: The Stylist checks the local weather, your calendar, and your closet to put together a complete outfit for you.
sections.stylist_step6: Listen to the Stylist's spoken advice, tap **Play Reply** to hear it again, or save the suggested outfit to your collection!

sections.profile_item3_desc: Add your name, phone number for notifications, and home address with automatic street and city lookup.

sections.profile_item5_desc: Share your daily routine and occupation so outfit suggestions and fashion trends match your everyday life.
sections.profile_item6_desc: Switch anytime between metric (cm / kg) and imperial (in / lb) units across all sizing fields.
sections.profile_item7_desc: If you are a professional stylist, tailor, or designer, register your business profile to appear in the Stylist Directory and launch local promotions.
sections.profile_item8_desc: Add your PayPal email to receive earnings when you sell items in the Marketplace.

help.overview_onboarding: Getting started takes under 60 seconds: calibrate your style DNA, 3D avatar measurements, and 24-piece Starter Capsule to see your first weather-aware AI outfit before you even sign in.
help.best_practice_p1: Follow these simple habits to build an accurate digital closet, make the most of your daily credits, and get tailored outfit recommendations every day.
help.best_practice_step1: **Complete Your Profile First**: Set your body measurements, favorite colors, style preferences, and modesty level in your **Profile** before uploading clothes.
help.best_practice_step2: **Capture Clear Photos**: Upload a single item laid flat, a full-outfit mirror photo, or — on **Manager** and **Professional** plans, or **Free** accounts holding **15 or more AI reconstruction credits** — photograph garments hanging in your closet, on a hanger, on a shoe rack, or in a folded pile.
help.best_practice_step3: **Know Cluster Upload Fallbacks**: Cluster upload is forbidden for Free users (one photo can exhaust their reconstruction allowance). It is best for solid or simple plaid/striped items, cannot analyze hidden prints or fine details, rarely reflects garment condition, may skip some items, can hallucinate patterns or colors, and consumes reconstruction credits.
help.best_practice_step4: **Build Your Closet in 5 Days**: Free users can use their 10 free daily credits (accumulating up to 300 over 30 days) to add 10 items a day and digitize a 50-item core wardrobe in 5 days.
help.best_practice_step5: **Review Your Item Card (10 Seconds)**: Quickly verify the detected category, color, warmth, and dress code—especially after cluster reconstruction—so your stylist always has accurate details.
help.qa_p1: Quick answers to the most common questions about getting started, managing your credits, digitizing your wardrobe, and styling outfits.
help.qa_step1: **How do I start on Day 1?** Complete your **Profile** measurements and style preferences first, then add your 10 most-worn everyday items.
help.qa_step2: **How do free credits work?** Free accounts receive **10 daily credits** (accumulating up to 300 over 30 days) for single-item and outfit scans plus stylist chats, along with **5 starter Studio Reconstruction credits**.
help.qa_step3: **How do Free users unlock Cluster Upload?** Cluster uploading (closets, hangers, shoe racks, or shirt piles) uses Nano Banana AI studio reconstruction and can process up to 15 garments per photo. Free users unlock the Cluster pipeline whenever they hold **15 or more AI reconstruction credits** (by purchasing an AI credit pack on the Pricing page), or by upgrading to a **Manager** or **Professional** plan.
help.qa_step4: **What can Cluster Upload digitize, and what are its limitations?** With **15+ AI reconstruction credits** or a **Manager** / **Professional** plan, you can photograph clothes hanging in your closet, a rack of shoes, or a pile of shirts to digitize your closet in no time. Note that it works best on solid or simple plaid/striped items, cannot read hidden prints or fine details, rarely reflects wear condition, may skip some items, can hallucinate patterns or colors, and consumes 1 reconstruction credit per reconstructed item.
help.qa_step5: **What happens if I demote from Manager or Professional to the Free plan?** You will lose your extra closet slots, **leaving only the last 50 added items** in your closet. DressApp warns you that older closet assets will be permanently lost and asks for your confirmation before accepting the demotion.
help.best_practice_step6: **Give the Stylist 4 Clues**: Mention your **occasion**, **setting**, **weather**, and **desired look** when asking the AI Stylist for an outfit.
help.qa_step6: **Is my wardrobe private?** Yes. Your photos and measurements are private to your account, and **DressApp's on-premises AI model** processes your wardrobe directly within our private environment.
help.tiers_demotion_desc: Manager and Professional users who demote to the Free plan lose their extra closet slots, leaving only the last 50 added items in their closet. Older closet assets are permanently removed after you confirm the demotion warning.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: DressApp privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacy.intro: DressApp ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application.
privacy.dataCollection: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email address, phone number, profile photos, body measurements, style preferences, and payment information. We also collect data automatically, such as device information, usage analytics, and cookies.
privacy.dataUse: Your data is used to provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, process transactions, send relevant notifications, and ensure the security and integrity of our platform.
privacy.dataSharing: We do not sell your personal data. We may share limited information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, subject to strict confidentiality obligations.
privacy.aiUsage: Our AI-powered stylist and measurement prediction features process your body measurements and photos locally or on secure servers to generate personalized recommendations. No biometric data is shared with advertisers or third parties.
privacy.storage: Data is stored securely using encryption at rest and in transit. We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
privacy.retention: We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide our services. You may request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time through your account settings or by contacting us.
privacy.rights: You have the right to access, correct, export, and delete your personal data. You may also opt out of data processing for marketing purposes at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us through the app or at our privacy email.
privacy.cookies: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyze usage, and personalize content. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.
privacy.contact: For any privacy-related inquiries, please reach out to us through the app settings or via the contact form on our website at dressapp.co.
